name: Arvind Kulkarni
education: B.Tech in Ocean Engineering, IIT Madras
bio: Arvind spends most of his weekdays analyzing sonar data and hull stress models at a naval research consultancy in Visakhapatnam. On weekends he volunteers at a local sea turtle conservation project, tagging hatchlings before they reach the surf. He has been teaching himself Carnatic flute for the past two years, practicing on his apartment balcony overlooking the harbor. His friends know him as the person who always carries a battered paperback of Urdu poetry in his messenger bag, even to engineering conferences.
